0:
cache:
  enabled: true
  dir: /data/cache
  port: 8088
  proxy_port: 8089
container:
  docker_host: "-"
  workdir_parent: shared/workdir
host:
  workdir_parent: /data/act
kubernetes:
  namespace: forgejo
  poll_timeout: 10m
log:
  level: info
plugins:
  k8s:
    address: "unix:///plugin/forgejo-runner-k8s.sock"
    options:
      namespace: forgejo
      poll_timeout: 10m
      labels: "app.kubernetes.io/name=forgejo-runner-instance,egress.home.arpa/custom-egress=true"
      resources: |
        requests:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 256Mi
        limits:
          memory: 1Gi
runner:
  capacity: 3
  labels:
    - ubuntu-latest:k8s:///config/podspec-default.yaml
    - default:k8s:///config/podspec-default.yaml
    - docker:k8s:///config/podspec-dind.yaml
    - multiarch:k8s:///config/podspec-dind.yaml  # you need binfmt-misc extension for multiarch
  timeout: 3h
  shutdown_timeout: 3m

containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS
        value: "4"
      - name: MAKEFLAGS
        value: "-j4"
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04@sha256:fea688b875acdce4e7c786d117b30c1b0203271b23e77d80c306b373d9f5422f
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 1
        memory: 2Gi
      limits:
        cpu: 6
        memory: 16Gi
# runner-k8s-plugin defaults the shared workdir emptyDir to 10Gi,
# too small for CEF builds; kubelet evicts the pod on emptydirfs.limit.
volumes:
  - name: shared
    emptyDir:
      sizeLimit: 50Gi
affinity:
  nodeAffinity:
    preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - weight: 100
        preference:
          matchExpressions:
            - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
              operator: In
              values:
                - kharkiv
restartPolicy: Never

initContainers:
  - name: dind
    image: docker:29-dind
    args:
      - --ipv6
      - --fixed-cidr-v6=fd00:d1d::/64
    securityContext:
      privileged: true
    restartPolicy: Always
    env:
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR
        value: /certs
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 250m
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        cpu: 4
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-storage
        mountPath: /var/lib/docker
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
    startupProbe:
      exec:
        command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - docker --tlsverify --tlscacert=/certs/client/ca.pem --tlscert=/certs/client/cert.pem --tlskey=/certs/client/key.pem -H tcp://localhost:2376 info
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 1
      failureThreshold: 30
containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: DOCKER_HOST
        value: tcp://localhost:2376
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
        value: "1"
      - name: DOCKER_CERT_PATH
        value: /certs/client
      - name: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS
        value: "4"
      - name: MAKEFLAGS
        value: "-j4"
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04@sha256:fea688b875acdce4e7c786d117b30c1b0203271b23e77d80c306b373d9f5422f
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 1
        memory: 2Gi
      limits:
        cpu: 6
        memory: 16Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
        readOnly: true
volumes:
  - name: docker-storage
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: docker-certs
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: shared
    emptyDir:
      sizeLimit: 50Gi
affinity:
  nodeAffinity:
    preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - weight: 100
        preference:
          matchExpressions:
            - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
              operator: In
              values:
                - kharkiv
restartPolicy: Never

/bin/ollama serve &
SERVE_PID=$!
sleep 5
ollama pull nomic-embed-text
kill $SERVE_PID 2>/dev/null
exit 0
